notes:
• ✎ Custom offer (Draft): type the cash and/or store-credit total you agreed with the customer — every card's amount is adjusted so it adds up exactly on the printout, the iPad and the Square unit cost. Shows the calculated offer next to it; Remove goes back
• 🧾 End of day (Tickets tab, or File → End-of-day buys): prints every offer accepted on a day — time, offer / ticket, customer, paid as, cards, market, amount, signed / Square / gift card — with cash paid out, store credit, e-gift and total bought, plus every card under each buy. Pick its printer in Settings → Printers → End-of-day buys
